deployments_detail.use: "MSCI AI Portfolio Insights" (GenAI + analytics for risk) + AI/alt-data in ESG ratings; Google Cloud GenAI climate tools

MSCI IndexAI Insights — a conversational AI interface letting clients ask plain-language questions about index performance, exposures, constituents and methodologies. Delivered via an MSCI app in OpenAI's ChatGPT and an MSCI connector in Claude, spanning 68,000+ indexes and up to 20 years of data. [OpenAI (ChatGPT), Anthropic (Claude)]
deployments_detail.value: 68,000+ indexes, up to 20 years of data

deployments_detail.use: AI connectors giving clients secure access to MSCI proprietary data from leading AI services — MSCI app in OpenAI ChatGPT, MSCI connector in Claude, and a Private Assets Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (with Microsoft Copilot coming soon) to query, measure and analyze data where they work. [OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft (Copilot, planned)]

MSCI AI Portfolio Insights — the firm's first generative-AI-powered solution, an AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about portfolio risk in seconds by assembling portfolio data and generating code, surfacing key risk drivers and outliers to automate risk analysis. [none]

GeoSpatial Asset Intelligence — AI-driven document parsing/extraction plus geospatial processing to deliver asset-level physical and nature risk data down to individual property/facility locations, built on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Google Earth). [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Google Earth)]
AskPCI — an LLM-powered search and analysis tool within Private Capital Intel that lets clients search, summarize and construct benchmarks over the MSCI fund data set. [none]

MSCI Diligence Platform (via acquisition of Vantager) — an AI-native platform that automates early-stage private-markets pre-investment due diligence, turning unstructured GP documents into AI-powered reports and standardized, decision-ready outputs. [none]

MSCI enterprise intelligence agent launched with Snowflake Intelligence — clients ask natural-language questions and get insights into the investment characteristics driving portfolio risk and performance. [Snowflake (Cortex AI / Snowflake Intelligence)]

AI-supported custom index creation — MSCI uses AI-enabled tools to translate unstructured client requirements into structured index specifications, enabling custom indexes to be built quickly and at scale rather than through a slow manual process. [none]

Data Acquisition Platform (DAP) — internal data operations platform using generative AI and agentic frameworks to process alternative/unstructured climate data at scale, cutting the model development lifecycle from ~6 months to weeks. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, LLMs)]
deployments_detail.value: model development cut from ~6 months to weeks
